raw_segments.text: Buckingham, I never looked for better at his hands after he once fell in with Mistress
Yet had we not determined he should die until your lordship came to see his end which now
the loving haste of these our friends, something against our meanings, have prevented, because,
my lord, we would have had you heard the traitor speak, and timorously confess the manner and
the purpose of his treasons, that you might well have signified the same unto the citizens,
who happily may misconstrue us in him, and wail his death.
